name: Personal Planner
description: daily planning, schedule, focus blocks, and task review
qualityGates: app-only screenshot is exactly 1080x2340 at density 480 Phone
first screen communicates the product purpose without external explanation
bottom navigation is anchored near the bottom with only a small home-indicator gap
content is not hidden by navigation and no large empty footer remains
icons, labels, search/add controls, and circular actions are centered in fixed containers
every visible primary control has visible feedback and appears in the scenario test plan
text is readable, unclipped, non-overlapping, and not dependent on network assets
implementation stays single-file dynamic ArkTS friendly and under 3000 LOC unless user asks otherwise
planner inputs define control-to-state-to-downstream propagation before implementation
availability, preferences, goals, units, and settings each have individual scenario evidence
editable inputs prove current-screen feedback and downstream changes in generated plan, overview, calendar, data, settings, or progress surfaces
charts and summaries are state-derived or explicitly labeled fixed sample estimates

source.inspiredBy: Open Design portable design-system package shape
source.notes: Structure inspiration only; generated ArkTS UI must be original and ArkTS-native.

constraints: no backend and no network assets by default
avoid Text.fontColor unless the current previewer has explicitly verified it
